variants.name: A｜細い目盛り
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished portrait iPhone app screen, edge-to-edge screenshot, no phone frame, no collage. Input image is a visual reference for the existing approved lofi work screen. Preserve the beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk rooftop scene, small white-haired girl working at a keyboard, warm table lamp, navy night city, plants and right-edge semicircular spectrum with Night Signal. Keep the large 18:42 stopwatch in upper center, tiny 作業中 badge above it, two lower circular pause/end controls with small dark glass labels, and bottom three-tab dark translucent frosted glass navigation 作業 / コレクション / 設定. Only redesign the TOP LEFT growth indicator and align header there: title ネオンの向こうの屋上 in elegant warm white serif at the top LEFT with generous safe area margin, then the rank/progress component described below. Header occupies only a compact upper-left area, not a large card or full-width widget. Preserve quiet refined cream typography, near-black/navy color palette, authentic implementable iOS UI, excellent legibility. No neon glowing UI, no ornamental panels, no new features. Rank is 4/5 and progress towards next rank is 72%, remaining 7 minutes. Do not conflate 4/5 rank with the current-rank progress. Render Japanese cleanly. Variant A: replace the capsule progress bar with a precise fine horizontal ruler beneath a small 4/5 label. About 25 vertical hairline ticks across 150pt, subtly varying lengths every fifth tick, the first 72% warm ivory and the rest low-opacity white. NO filled pill track, NO chunky segments. Tiny restrained end marker at current progress, caption 進化まであと7分 beneath in muted ivory. It should feel like a premium audio instrument scale with beautiful spacing, understated and sophisticated.
